title: ELISA for IL-10 Detection
author: Tamiris Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.92dh8a6
materials: On the day of the assay, bring all reagents to room temperature (RT) prior to use.
Read absorbance at 450 nm at 15 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and store serum
steps.instruction: Use a 10 mL vacuette tube (red cap) and a 25 × 8 vacutainer needle (green) to draw 10 mL peripheral blood; centrifuge 10 min at 1,000 × g in a refrigerated centrifuge; transfer the serum layer, aliquot 300 µL into 1.5 mL microtubes and store at < ‑80 °C.

steps.title: Coat plate with capture antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the capture antibody in coating buffer, add 100 µL of this solution to each well of a 96‑well plate, and incubate overnight at 2 °C–8 °C.

steps.title: Wash plate after coating
steps.instruction: Wash the plate 4 times with ≥300 µL wash buffer per well; after each wash tap the plate firmly onto absorbent paper to remove residual buffer.

steps.title: Block plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 hour with shaking (≈500 rpm, 0.3 cm orbital radius).

steps.title: Prepare standards and samples
steps.instruction: While the plate is blocking, prepare the required standard dilutions and serum samples for the assay.

steps.title: Wash plate after blocking
steps.instruction: Wash the plate 4 times with 300 µL wash buffer per well.

steps.title: Add standards and samples
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL per well of each standard dilution to the designated wells and 100 µL per well of each serum sample to its well.

steps.title: Incubate samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 2 hours with shaking (same conditions as blocking).

steps.title: Wash plate after sample incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the plate 4 times with 300 µL wash buffer per well.

steps.title: Add detection antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of diluted detection antibody solution to each well, seal the plate, and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour with shaking.

steps.title: Wash plate after detection antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the plate 4 times with wash buffer (300 µL per well).

steps.title: Add Avidin‑HRP
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of diluted Avidin‑HRP solution to each well and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes with shaking.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Wash the plate 5 times with 300 µL wash buffer per well; for the final wash, leave the wells in wash buffer for 30 seconds to 1 minute.

steps.title: Add TMB substrate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL TMB substrate solution to each well and incubate in the dark for 30 minutes or until the desired blue color develops.

steps.title: Stop reaction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL stop solution to each well; positive wells will change from blue to yellow.

description: To block non-specific binding and reduce background, add 200 μL Assay Diluent per well.
